stemMd: A bag contains 3 red and 5 blue tokens. Two tokens are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red? Enter the probability as a decimal rounded to three decimal places.
explanationMd: The probability is (3/8)(2/7)=6/56=3/28≈0.107142857. Rounded to three decimal places, this is 0.107. The second denominator is seven because the first token is not replaced.
